materials.content:
Graphite on moderately thick, white, moderately textured wove paper
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Private collection, Santa Fe, New Mexico, gift, 1975; Grete Meilman Fine Art, Ltd., New York, NY, and Zaplin-Lampert Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1989; Grete Meilman Fine Art, Ltd., New York, NY, 1990; (Linda Hyman Fine Arts, New York, NY); Bill Dean, New York, NY, 1996; (Tibor de Nagy, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. The subject depicted is O'Keeffe's studio in Taos, 1929; identification of it based on Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. See cat. nos. 657–59. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Light sketches of walls and doorways contrast with the plain white paper that forms the background.
title: Untitled (Taos Studio)
